name: deeptutor-task-env-v1
used_as: lower-agent runtime executed on the host inside bubblewrap (agentloop/isolated_runtime.py binds sys.prefix and sys.base_prefix read-only); replaces the host venv of the 0902 pilot
notes: Must be built on the host (not in a container) because bubblewrap runs it from host paths. build-host.sh installs the pinned CPython with uv into $AGENTSWE_HOME/python and creates the venv at $AGENTSWE_HOME/envs/deeptutor-task-env-v1/venv.
layout: <env dir>/venv is the virtualenv (python at venv/bin/python)
